body:
Version 2.2.4

Framework:

- [New] BUG-10179 MIDI Learn: Invert option per mapping. Incoming CC
        values and outgoing feedback can now be inverted (a new
        "Invert" checkbox in the MIDI Learn settings page).
- [Imp] Support parsing of ".mid" files that are not really midi but
        raw sysex
- [Imp] ParameterDescriptions: "toText" now accepts an object form
        {format, scale, offset} that synthesises a value list at load
        time. Lets devices with non-7-bit native parameter ranges
        declare native min/max and produce human-readable display text
        without controller-side scaling.

- [Fix] BUG-10177 Third-party skins: Plugin-specific settings pages
        (e.g. Voice Expansion) are now loaded from the embedded plugin
        binary when a skin is loaded from disk
- [Fix] BUG-10189 Fix crash on the audio thread when a rate-limited
        parameter is automated by the DAW.

OsTIrus:

- [New] BUG-10194 Master Tune is now exposed as a public parameter,
        bipolar (signed, +/-64 cents). Available for host automation
- [New] BUG-10184 Patch Manager now supports Multi and Arrangement
        patches alongside Singles. Multi, Arrangement (Multi + 16
        Singles) and Single dumps are detected automatically on file
        import and tagged via the new "Type" category. Arrangement
        loading from Patch Manager switches to Multi mode, applies
        the multi and distributes the 16 referenced Singles into the
        parts. A new "ROM Arrangements" data source exposes factory
        arrangements from Osirus (ABC) ROMs (not available for
        OsTIrus TI ROMs). Arrangements can also be saved to user
        banks via the Save menu. Dropping a Multi or Arrangement onto
        a Part Button prompts for confirmation since the target
        affects more than just that part.

Osirus:

- [New] BUG-10194 Master Tune is now exposed as a public parameter,
        bipolar (signed, +/-64 cents). Available for host automation
- [New] BUG-10184 Patch Manager now supports Multi and Arrangement
        patches alongside Singles. Multi, Arrangement (Multi + 16
        Singles) and Single dumps are detected automatically on file
        import and tagged via the new "Type" category. Arrangement
        loading from Patch Manager switches to Multi mode, applies
        the multi and distributes the 16 referenced Singles into the
        parts. A new "ROM Arrangements" data source exposes factory
        arrangements from Osirus (ABC) ROMs (not available for
        OsTIrus TI ROMs). Arrangements can also be saved to user
        banks via the Save menu. Dropping a Multi or Arrangement onto
        a Part Button prompts for confirmation since the target
        affects more than just that part.

Vavra:

- [Fix] BUG-10172 Voice Expansion: fix audio dropouts and short CPU
        stalls, especially noticeable at small buffer sizes
- [Fix] Fix possible crash during shutdown

Xenia:

- [Fix] Voice Expansion: lower UC-thread latency, reducing audio
        glitches at small buffer sizes (shared fix with Vavra)
